identitySignals: Agenda names 'Regents of the University of California (Berkeley campus)' in Berkeley, CA; UC Berkeley's official site (berkeley.edu) describes the campus as part of the University of California system, matching the agenda location

UC Berkeley's School of Education publicly describes a partnership with Oakland Unified School District (Principal Leadership Institute / DELPI), consistent with a 2022-23 OUSD-UC Berkeley service agreement from the Talent office
The Regents' official site (regents.universityofcalifornia.edu) identifies the Regents of the University of California as the governing body of the UC system, which includes the Berkeley campus
research.notes: Campus operator number is for the campus, not the Regents' office. Email on contact page is obfuscated, so omitted. No registry IDs verified; the Regents is a constitutional state entity.

profile.summary: The University of California, Berkeley is a public research university in Berkeley, California, and one of the campuses of the University of California system. It offers undergraduate, graduate and professional degree programs and conducts research. The Regents of the University of California is the governing board of the university system.

review.notes: The agenda names the Regents of the University of California (Berkeley campus) in Berkeley, CA, and the profile describes UC Berkeley and its governing Regents; the OUSD-UC Berkeley partnership page corroborates the relationship. The campus operator phone 510-642-6000 is confirmed on the contact page, and the summary is neutral and consistent with the cited sources (the Regents-as-governing-board claim is only implied by the Regents site but is accurate and well known).
